successors.name: Ottoman Empire
successors.text: the Hejaz (the Jeddah walilik), which stays Ottoman when the African coast goes to Egypt

ledger.x: 1557: the Ottoman province of Habesh is formed.
1813: Muhammad Ali receives the administration of Habesh.
1827: the administration returns to the Ottomans.
1846: Massawa and Suakin pass to Muhammad Ali again.
1849: Massawa and Suakin return to the Ottoman governors at Muhammad Ali's death ("until his death in 1849").
1865: the African coast leaves the eyalet.

1872: Habesh Eyalet is disestablished (infobox "Disestablished: 1872"); the walilik of Jeddah, abolished for a year, "was brought back the following year", and the Hejaz continues as an Ottoman province ("transformed into the Hejaz Vilayet, with a governor in Mecca", no year on the page).

wars.name: Ottoman expansion into the Abyssinian highlands
wars.outcome: "Ottoman expansion inland was halted in 1578" and Ottoman authority in the highlands then receded.

certainty.note: Coastal stations and ports; no inland frontier is given.
